opening.argument: The video tests a specific compatibility question: whether a Vanilla Mastercard gift card can be added to Cash App as a payment method. It walks through the card setup, then reports the result: “Card Not Supported.” That outcome supports an operational demonstration, not a claim that the card will work. The description separately invites viewers to try Cash App using a referral code, with a stated $5 reward for each person. Nothing in the supplied evidence establishes deception or additional conditions attached to that invitation. The referral does not change what the demonstration shows.

citations.quote: we're going to see if we can add our vanilla MasterCard gift card into the cash app and use it as a payment method
You wanna click on this button right here. Called Add Debit Card.
a few seconds later, this screen pops up saying Card Not Supported.
